feedback.claim: The responsibility matrix still requires exact timezone releases to be available, contradicting the accepted byte-identical substitute strategy.
feedback.evidence: Section 3 specifies “Exact versions available before affected work runs” for timezone-data installation and release compatibility. Section 8.2 instead permits automatic per-zone byte-identity resolution as one of three deployment strategies, including an unseen runtime release without the authored release installed.
feedback.recommended_change: Change the matrix boundary to require exact authored-version data or a byte-identical resolver admitted under Decision 0006 before affected work runs.
feedback.severity_rationale: This is a localized wording contradiction in the amended policy's deployment requirements. The detailed admission rule is clear, so a small alignment fix suffices.
